# Anchor: Tony Hoare. The installed compiler stores types in syntax nodes,
# so declaration validation must not depend on a populated Info.Types map.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Imported and local constants retain declaration scope; both uint8 bounds
# are accepted. Native, ejected, and upstream executions agree.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^defaults checked: 1000000000 17 0 255$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ../../bad

# None of these types is instantiated. Opaque disables generated serializers,
# so rejection must come from declaration validation rather than generated Go.
cp ../cases/below.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'default for field Value.*overflows'
! logos eject -o $WORK/below-out
stderr 'default for field Value.*overflows'

cp ../cases/above.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'default for field Value.*overflows'
! logos eject -o $WORK/above-out
stderr 'default for field Value.*overflows'

cp ../cases/scalar.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'cannot use.*default for field Value'
! logos eject -o $WORK/scalar-out
stderr 'cannot use.*default for field Value'

cp ../cases/composite.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr 'cannot use.*default for field Value'
! logos eject -o $WORK/composite-out
stderr 'cannot use.*default for field Value'

cp ../cases/mapkey.lgo defaults.lgo
! logos build .
stderr '\[correctness::default_not_constant\] non-constant default for field Value'
! logos eject -o $WORK/mapkey-out
stderr '\[correctness::default_not_constant\] non-constant default for field Value'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/defaultvalidation

go 1.27

-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

type Imported struct { Delay time.Duration = time.Second }
type Bounds struct {
	Min uint8 = 0
	Max uint8 = 255
}

func main() {
	const amount = 17
	type Local struct { Value int = amount }
	a := Imported{}
	b := Local{}
	c := Bounds{}
	if a.Delay != time.Second || b.Value != 17 || c.Min != 0 || c.Max != 255 {
		panic("wrong declaration default")
	}
	fmt.Printf("defaults checked: %d %d %d %d\n", a.Delay, b.Value, c.Min, c.Max)
}

-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/unuseddefault

go 1.27

-- cases/below.lgo --
package bad

type Unused struct {
	Value uint8 = -1
	Opaque map[int]int
}

-- cases/above.lgo --
package bad

type Unused struct {
	Value uint8 = 256
	Opaque map[int]int
}

-- cases/scalar.lgo --
package bad

type Unused struct {
	Value int = "bad"
	Opaque map[int]int
}

-- cases/composite.lgo --
package bad

type Unused struct {
	Value []int = []string{"bad"}
	Opaque map[int]int
}

-- cases/mapkey.lgo --
package bad

var Calls int

func key() int {
	Calls++
	return 1
}

type Unused struct {
	Value map[int]int = map[int]int{key(): 1}
	Opaque map[int]int
}
